title: Timeline Test Vector File
description: A collection of timeline vectors: the exact payload of one media or event timeline Object, uncompressed, or the value of a track's media timeline template, paired with the records it holds or the complaint it must draw.

topic.description: What the file exercises, and its file name without the extension: 'media', 'event' and 'template' for MSF, 'sap' for the CMSF SAP Type timeline.

format.description: What each input is. mediatimeline: the payload of a media timeline Object (MSF 7.1). eventtimeline: the payload of an event timeline Object (MSF 8.1). template: the value of a track's template field (MSF-01 5.2.15, 7.4.1).

event_type.description: The catalog eventType of the timeline track, which defines the structure of each record's data. Absent when data is read as it is, with no eventType's definition applied.

spec_section.description: The section of the draft most of the file's vectors cite. Each vector's description cites its own.

sap_record.description: One SAP Type timeline record (CMSF 3.6.1): its Location and its data. Integers are strings of decimal digits.

group_id.description: The first item of the 'l' Location.

object_id.description: The second item of the 'l' Location.

ept_ms.description: The second integer of data: the earliest presentation time of the Object's samples, in milliseconds.

media_record.description: One media timeline record (MSF 7.1), or one entry a template yields (MSF-01 7.4.1). Integers are strings of decimal digits.

media_time_ms.description: The first item: the media presentation timestamp, in milliseconds.

group_id.description: The first number of the second item, the Location.

object_id.description: The second number of the Location.

event_record.description: One event timeline record (MSF 8.1) read as it is: the key of its index reference, that reference's value, and data. Integers are strings of decimal digits.

index.description: The index reference the record carries.

group_id.description: 'l': the first item of the Location.

object_id.description: 'l': the second item of the Location.

data.description: The record's data, the JSON value as the payload has it.

template.description: The six values of a media timeline template (MSF-01 7.4.1), each Location split into its Group ID and Object ID. Integers are strings of decimal digits.

id.description: Unique identifier within the file. Kebab-case.

description.description: What the case tests, and the sentence of the draft that decides it.

text.description: The payload, or the template value, as text. Its UTF-8 encoding is the bytes.

entries.description: Template vectors that decode: how many entries decoded.records lists, n = 0 up to entries - 1.

records.description: Every record of the payload, in payload order: SAP Type timeline records for the eventType org.ietf.moq.cmsf.sap, event records for an event timeline without event_type, media records for a media timeline. Nothing is merged or dropped. For a template, the entries mediaTime[n], location[n] and wallclock[n] of MSF-01 7.4.1.

error.description: Error category for invalid vectors. invalid_json: the input is not JSON text (RFC 8259). invalid_value: the payload, the template, a record, a Location, a time or data is not of the shape or within the values the draft allows. missing_field: a record or the template lacks a required field or item. invalid_index: an event record's index reference is not exactly one of the keys the draft allows.

error_detail.description: Optional human-readable detail: the path of the value at fault, such as records[0].data[0], records[0][2] or template[3].
